statement: On each day an employer pays qualifying earnings to an employee (the QE day), an individual superannuation guarantee amount arises at the charge percentage of 12, and a superannuation guarantee shortfall — carrying notional earnings at the general interest charge rate and a 60% administrative uplift — arises unless eligible superannuation contributions are received by the employee's fund within the usual period, which starts on the QE day and ends on the seventh business day after it.
caveat: This is the payday-super regime in force from 1 July 2026, which replaced the quarterly 28-day contribution deadlines; extended periods apply for a new employee's first contribution to a fund and the other table items in section 18C(2). The maximum contributions base and exemption certificates can reduce the amount.
